teach.goal: Ponte português → inglês com palavras úteis.

facts.label: Passado ou present perfect
facts.sub: Com tempo terminado (last year, yesterday), use o passado simples. Com tempo não terminado (this year, this week) ou since/for, use o present perfect.

facts.label: No ano passado
facts.sub: Last year é um tempo terminado, então use o passado: She worked here last year. I finished six projects last year. Outros: yesterday, last week, in 2022.

facts.label: Este ano
facts.sub: This year ainda não acabou, então o present perfect combina: I’ve finished two projects this year. Com this week e this month, também pode usar o present perfect.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ano passado” e “este ano” com o pretérito perfeito.
compare.us: Em inglês, last year pede o passado: I finished six. This year pode pedir o present perfect: I’ve finished two.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Last year is a finished time.
We say “I have finished six projects last year.”
items.why: We say I finished six projects last year.

items.s: This year is not finished yet.
items.why: Yes: I’ve finished two this year.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Last year is a finished time. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I have finished six projects last year.” → Falso (We say I finished six projects last year.)
This year is not finished yet. → Verdadeiro (Yes: I’ve finished two this year.)

pages.title: A busy office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy Monday morning in an office in Ottawa. Noah has a new desk near the window. He has worked here for a few months. His colleague Carl brings him a coffee. They talk about people who left last year. Carl wants to compare last year with this year.
“Noah, did you meet Rita? She worked here last year.” says Carl. “No, I didn’t. I’ve only worked here since January.” says Noah. “She left in December. She has found a new job at a bank.” says Carl.
